notes.title: Update Notes (April 5th)
notes.content:
Fixed some scenes where one of the characters was invisible.
Fixed some rewards in the achievements room.
Fixes to the "As good as new" achievement.

notes.title: Update notes (April 3rd)
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that didn't let damage related achievements be activated.
Fixed availability of the Bull Horn item: now Behemoth-type Xempts can drop it.
Xempts that only showed up in a limited area can now appear in Necropolis so players who missed them in the first area can still fill the enemy list.
Fixed a bug that made Supernova hit each character more times than it should.
Increased apparition rate of Sandstorm.

notes.title: Update notes (April 2nd)
notes.content: Fixed a critical bug before the final boss that emptied the party and made it impossible to continue.

notes.title: Update notes (March 29th)
notes.content:
Reduced encounter rate in certain areas.
Fixed a bug where a character walked through a table during a scene.
Changed the first scene of Royalix. Now part of Lastia's history is told in a book of the inn so it's not mandatory to read it.
Some typos fixed.
